- Series and movies opens as a screen of its own from YTXTube (before it opened the downloads page with a window over it, and the downloads page showed through).
- Size per episode or movie is typed in GB (0.2 to 60). Pulse looks from a quarter of it up to nearly twice it (never under 200 MB), the bigger ones first, the most shared first.
- Tapping an episode opens its streams: who shares each one (the add-on's own number) and its size, to choose from. The ticking of episodes is gone; the season button downloads the whole season.
- A torrent nobody shares gives way to the next stream after 10 seconds (20 when peers are connected).
- Torrent engine: 21 trackers instead of 6, including HTTPS ones that work where UDP is blocked, and a list of working trackers fetched once a day.
- The packs (wallpapers in 4K, icon packs, skins, …) are not listed in Extra apps any more: they are in Settings > About (Downloaded packs) and in the launcher's Microsoft Store, which is drawn like Windows 11's Store (see-through, a rail of places at the left, a search box, a banner and cards).
- Storage (Settings > About): each folder says what it holds and breaks down by kind (count and size). Game Hub keeps one box per game; the boxes of old styles that piled up are deleted when the shelf opens.
- YTXTube icon: the play button is smaller and centred.
